p.PROJECT-RUNS-TWO-WRITERS-OVER-ONE-FILE-S: This project runs **two writers over one file set** — a human and a coding agent both edit the spec tree, the tests, and the code.

p.CONTRADICTIONS-ARE-NORMAL-COOPERATION-NO: They *will* write contradictory things; that is normal cooperation, not an error.

p.WHAT-IS-FORBIDDEN-IS-RESOLVING-A-CONTRAD: What is forbidden is resolving a contradiction silently.

p.EVERY-DISAGREEMENT-IS-SETTLED-BY-FIXED-P: Every disagreement between layers is settled by fixed priority:

facts.HUMAN-MAY-CHANGE-THE-SPEC-AND-NOBODY-ELS: The human may change the spec; nobody else may — silently.
facts.CODE-MUST-CONFORM-TO-THE-SPEC: Code must conform to the spec, never the other way around.
facts.TESTS-ARE-THE-SPEC-IN-EXECUTABLE-FORM: Tests are the spec in executable form: a test that contradicts the spec is a bug in exactly one of the two, never both.
facts.THE-VOLATILE-STATE-FILE-IS-A-RECORD-DEAD: The volatile state file (WAL or equivalent) is a record, dead last: when it disagrees with anything above it, it is stale.

p.IF-YOU-BELIEVE-THE-SPEC-IS-WRONG-IMPLEME: If you believe the spec is wrong: **implement the spec anyway**, add a marker at the point of disagreement —

p.SURFACE-THE-MARKER-IN-THE-END-OF-SESSION: — and surface it in the end-of-session report.

p.THE-HUMAN-DECIDES-IN-THE-NEXT-CYCLE: The human decides in the next cycle.

p.three-lines-seconds-to-write-a-minute-to: Three lines of text; seconds to write; a minute to read.

p.CLIMB-THE-LADDER-BEFORE-CHOOSING-A-CONSE: Re-read the relevant spec section → re-read the relevant reference chapter → check the closest analog in the project → if still unclear, pick the conservative interpretation (the one cheapest to reverse), mark it with a REVIEW, proceed, and flag it in the report.

facts.NEVER-SILENTLY-MODIFY-A-NORMATIVE-SPEC-V: Never silently modify a normative spec value.
facts.NEVER-RESOLVE-A-DISAGREEMENT-BY-ASSUMING: Never resolve a spec-vs-code disagreement by assuming the code is newer. Recency is not authority; the hierarchy is.
facts.NEVER-REMOVE-SOMEONE-ELSES-REVIEW-MARKER: Never remove someone else's REVIEW marker without resolving it.
facts.NEVER-INVENT-SEMANTICS-WHEN-THE-SPEC-IS-: Never invent semantics when the spec is silent — mark the choice and proceed conservatively.

p.recovery-drills-pointer: Recovery drills for when the protocol has already been broken: @spec://org.vibevm.world/conflict-protocol/flows/conflict-protocol/failure-modes#root.
